prompt: How many of the heaviest living animals can reach a maximum mass exceeding 60 tonnes?
answer:
**Seven** of the heaviest living animals can reach a maximum mass exceeding 60 tonnes:

1. Blue whale — up to 190 tonnes  
2. North Pacific right whale — up to 120 tonnes  
3. Southern right whale — up to 110 tonnes  
4. Fin whale — up to 120 tonnes  
5. Bowhead whale — up to 120 tonnes  
6. North Atlantic right whale — up to 110 tonnes  
7. Sperm whale — up to 80 tonnes  

These are approximate estimates, since whole-body weighing of large whales is difficult.
